steps.title: DR Architecture
steps.text: Multi-region disaster recovery uses async replication between primary and secondary regions, with tiered backup storage for daily snapshots, weekly backups, and monthly archives.

steps.title: RTO and RPO
steps.text: Recovery Time Objective (how fast you recover) and Recovery Point Objective (how much data you can lose) vary by strategy: cold standby costs less, hot standby recovers faster.

steps.title: Backup Strategy Tiers
steps.text: Use three backup tiers: continuous replication for immediate failover, periodic snapshots for quick restore, and archive backups for long-term compliance retention.

steps.title: Failover Procedures
steps.text: The failover decision tree evaluates whether the failure is complete, partial, or a network partition, then routes to automatic failover, manual evaluation, or monitoring.

steps.title: DR Metrics
steps.text: Track key DR metrics: RTO under 15 minutes, RPO under 5 minutes, replication lag under 1 minute, backup success above 99.9%, and monthly failover drills.
